response.rationale: All options map to the same top-ranked leaf 'Immune Complex Glomerulonephritis' with the same support and confidence scores. Options A, B, and C are subtypes, while D is a complication. Among the subtypes, option B is more specific ('Focal segmental necrotising immune-complex glomerulonephritis') and directly reflects findings from the renal biopsy ('focal segmental necrotising immune-complex glomerulonephritis with subendothelial deposits'). Option A is a more general 'Infection-related glomerulonephritis'. Option C, 'Membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis', is also a subtype but less specific to the biopsy findings than B. Option D, being a complication, is ranked last among the matched options.
